### Português

Para pagamento da taxa de inscrição de R$ 12,00, utilize a chave PIX 11960499760 (Isabela Lopes) e envie o comprovante de pagamento com o nome completo do competidor para o email [campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com](mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com)
Esta competição possui **limite de inscrições**, em caso de desistência, **entre em contato com a organização ([campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com](mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com))** para que a vaga possa ser disponibilizada para outra pessoa.



### English:
To pay the registration fee of R$ 12.00, use the PIX key 11960499760 (Isabela Lopes) and send the receipt with the competitor's full name to the following email address [campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com](mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com)
This competition has a **competitor limit**, in case of withdrawal, **contact the organization team ([campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com](mailto:campeonatocubo.golden@gmail.com))** so your spot can be given to someone else.

venue.name: Pakuranga United Rugby Club, Montressor's Function Centre

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTY1NDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--0612989b394d75053cc1db949e60d5519f3107af/Decathlon%2025.png)

New Zealand Cubing Decathlon 2025 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition.

This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary.

Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

items.name: Cuboss Open 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTAxNjk2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--21e72b3a5efeeda6237474706863e347bd165b70/cuboss-open-2025-logo-cropped.png)

Varmt välkomna till Cuboss Open 2025! Detta blir en väldigt speciell tävling, där WCA-grenarna blandas med en mängd olika specialgrenar. Dessutom kommer det ske väldigt mycket roliga grejer i lokalen. 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet.

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

--

Welcome to Cuboss Open 2025! This will be a very special competition, where the WCA events are mixed with a variety of special events. In addition, there will be a lot of other fun happenings at the venue. 

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.name: Hawaiʻi Big Island Fall 2025
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png)
### Speedcubing returns to the Big Island with another WCA competition, our first time in the fall!

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If you are a first time competitor it is highly encouraged to be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:30 AM.
